title: Combine Temporal and Language Alignment Losses
summary: Nearby visual states, meaningful language progress and compact features provide different learning signals.

frames: Declared normalized action/feature coordinates; no implicit frame conversion

units.values: Embedding coordinates, supplied logits, normalized robot state and normalized actions are dimensionless. Frame indices are ordinal positions, not timestamps in seconds.

physical_contract.axes: Video, frame, feature and policy-channel dimensions follow the typed contract
physical_contract.timestamp_assumptions: Triplets stay in one video and the negative comes from another. Policy rows are supplied observations with explicit training/evaluation membership; no temporal transitions are inferred.
physical_contract.batching: Video, frame, feature and policy-channel dimensions follow the typed contract

provenance.authoring_notes: Original bounded R3M component. The sampler is an explicit sequential recorded-draw recipe, the loss pins valid-row mean reduction and anchor regularization, and the policy uses an affine head rather than the paper's BatchNorm/MLP. No pretrained model or benchmark reproduction claim.
